messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using 当前 data 和 parameter 值.
messages.tip.angle: 最小 角间距, 在 度, between accepted 密度 maxima. Larger 值 keep fewer, 更多 widely separated 主极点; 较小 值 may retain nearby peaks 从 same orientation family.
messages.tip.bins: Sets KDE 密度-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher 值 reveal finer 密度 detail but require 更多 memory 和 computation. Use lowest 值 that resolves stable 密度 maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns 每个 point 到 closest 已审核 主极点 within JS cone threshold 和 writes JS 标量场. 已审核 pole table, not original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: 选择 number 的 rotation 度 的 freedom. Use 2 用于 original two-角度 rotation model 或 3 用于 intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used 按 three-degree-的-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: 选择 目标函数 minimised during optimisation. It controls how rotated pole orientations are penalised 或 distributed 在 colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage 的 有效 point 法向量 used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation 时间; 100% uses 全部 有效 法向量.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: 最大 number 的 differential-evolution generations. Higher 值 allow a 更多 extensive search but increase computation 时间.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used 按 differential evolution. Larger 值 evaluate 更多 candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort 和 computation 时间.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer 随机种子. 输入 a 值 到 make sampling 和 optimisation reproducible; leave blank 到 use a new 随机种子.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare 点云 coloured using 已选择 颜色空间 和 已选择 极点空间. original 点云 is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays relative pole-密度 distribution obtained 使用 optimised rotation. It does not run optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays point-normal 极点 之后 applying optimised rotation, using 已选择 stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When facets are created, also creates one separate 点云 用于 每个 final cluster. Disable this 用于 very large datasets if additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within 每个 positive JS family, estimates a family-specific eps, removes components 较小 than ppcluster, fits plane equations, 和 writes cl, A, B, C, D 和 sigma using original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts normal-colour optimisation 使用 parameters entered above 和 determines rotation angles that minimise 已选择 目标函数.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: 最小 number 的 点 inside DBSCAN neighbourhood, including point itself, required 用于 a core point. MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this 值 requires denser neighbourhoods 和 may classify 更多 点 as noise.
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates KDE pole-密度 surface 和 extracts automatic 主极点. Review 和, if necessary, edit resulting pole table 之前 assigning JS 组.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. 输入 a numeric 值 where appropriate; associated label indicates units 和 parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex 平面网格 用于 每个 有效 final cluster using its stored global point indices 和 fitted plane. 聚类 必须为 已完成 首先.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one 点云 用于 每个 positive JS family. Each 点云 contains that family’s 点 和 retains JS, cl 和 plane 标量场.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point 法向量 coloured 按 their 当前 JS 值 和 overlays 已审核 主极点. This is 可用 only when JS corresponds 到 当前 已审核 pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When 已选择, 每个 cluster 在 a JS family uses 已审核 family-pole normal 和 derives only D 从 cluster centroid. When cleared, 每个 cluster normal is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: 最大 angular difference, 在 度, between a point normal 和 a 已审核 主极点. closest pole inside this cone defines JS; 点 outside 全部 cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used 到 estimate eps separately 用于 每个 JS family. MATLAB method uses K=4 和 queries K+1 neighbours because 首先 结果 is point itself. Larger K represents a broader local 间距 scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier 在 eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. MATLAB method uses 2. Larger 值 increase eps 和 tend 到 join components across wider gaps; 较小 值 tend 到 split clusters.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides 和 stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only 和 do not affect calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: 最大 number 的 automatic 主极点 retained 从 密度 surface. It limits candidate JS 组; 已审核 pole table remains authoritative 和 can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold 基于 |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger 值 merge 更多 same-family clusters into a common plane; 较小 值 preserve 更多 separate 平面. Set 0 到 disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: 最小 component size 之后 DBSCAN, corresponding 到 MATLAB ppcluster. Components 使用 fewer 点 are rejected 和 assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots 全部 有效 point 法向量 as 极点 在 已选择 stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step 和 does not modify 点云.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new 主极点 从 倾向 和 倾角 值. table 和 密度 plot update immediately; family IDs are renumbered 和 existing JS 和 cluster 结果 become 已过期.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies 倾向 和 倾角 值 到 已选择 主极点. 已审核 table becomes source 的 truth, so JS classification 和 clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes 已选择 主极点, renumbers remaining 组 和 refreshes plot. Existing JS 和 cluster 结果 become 已过期.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves 已选择 pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes family IDs 和 requires JS classification 和 clustering 到 be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes family order. Because family IDs follow table order, changing order requires JS classification 和 clustering 到 be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative 已审核 list 的 主极点. JS classification, family plots, Fisher K 和 subsequent clustering use this exact order 和 orientation. Editing 或 reordering table invalidates existing JS 和 cluster 结果.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves 已选择 pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes family IDs 和 requires JS classification 和 clustering 到 be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, 密度 和 automatic peak detection use original 法向量 或 法向量 transformed 按 optimised rotation. Stored principal-pole orientations always remain 在 original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects stereographic projection used 用于 plots. Equal-角度 preserves angular relationships; 等面积 preserves area. This setting changes only visual projection, not original point 法向量 或 标量场.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes 已选择 CloudCompare entity 和 checks which 工作流程 actions 和 工具 commands have data required 到 run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only 使用 随机 cluster ordering. same seed reproduces numbering; leave blank 到 generate a new random order 用于 每个 run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays last 已计算 密度 和 当前 主极点 不使用 recalculating KDE 或 detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls final cl numbering within 每个 JS family. 大小 orders largest clusters 首先, D follows their spatial position along fitted normal, 和 随机 shuffles order. IDs restart at 1 用于 每个 family.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours 或 filled contours 用于 密度 plot. This changes visualisation only; 密度 值 和 detected 极点 are not recalculated.

messages.about.body:
Authors:
 Adrián Riquelme Guill
 Roberto Tomás Jover
 Antonio Abellán Fernández
 阿利坎特大学

Scientific references:
 Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
 A new approach 用于 semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
 从 3D 点云. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

 Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
 Discontinuity 间距 analysis 在 rock masses using 3D 点云.
 Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

 Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
 自动 mapping 的 discontinuity 延续性 在 rock masses using
 3D 点云. Rock Mechanics 和 Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
 https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

 Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
 方向-based colour mapping 和 spherical 密度 analysis 用于
 rock discontinuity detection 在 3D 点云 的 roadcut slopes.
 Journal 的 Rock Mechanics 和 Geotechnical Engineering.
 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

 Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
 Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
 familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
 evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University 的
 Alicante.
 https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based 在:
 Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation 的 Discontinuity Set
 Extractor (DSE), 土木工程系, University 的
 Alicante, Spain.

Libraries 和 algorithms:
 - NumPy: numerical arrays 和 vector operations.
 - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
 connected components 和 convex-hull geometry.
 - Matplotlib: stereonet, 密度 和 analysis plotting.
 - colorcet: scientific 和 perceptually useful colour maps used 按
 cluster visualisation.
 - Pillow: icon loading, resizing 和 GUI icon normalisation.
 - CloudCompare / pycc: point-点云, normal 和 scalar-字段 access.
 - Tkinter / ttk: graphical 用户 interface.
 - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D normal/sphere visualisation.

 Algorithms 和 methods:
 - DSE principal-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, 基于
 Botev et al. kernel-密度 approach.
 - Differential Evolution 用于 normal-colour rotation optimisation.
 - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) 用于 spatial clustering 的 discontinuity
 组.
 - Fisher directional statistics 用于 mean-pole concentration 和
 confidence intervals.
 - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches 和 Qhull convex-hull geometry
 through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
 CloudCompare development team 和 researchers whose methods
 underpin DSE 工作流程.
messages.colour.angles_unit_note: 旋转 angles are expressed 在 度 (°). Edit 值 和 press 应用 angles 到 use them manually.
messages.colour.error.invalid_angles: 旋转 angles 必须为 finite numeric 值.
messages.log.colour.manual_angles: Manual colour rotation applied: angles=[{angles}], objective={value:.6g}.
messages.tip.colour.rotation_angle: 旋转 角度 在 度. For 3 度 的 freedom these 字段 are intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler angles: Z (yaw), Y (pitch) 和 X (roll). For 2 度 的 freedom only 首先 two angles are used.
messages.gui.normal_spacing_results_saved: 法向量 间距 结果 saved.
messages.gui.normal_spacing_save_error: 无法 save 法向间距 结果: {error}
messages.gui.spacing_family: 组 到 analyse. 选择 全部 到 calculate 法向间距 用于 every 可用 discontinuity set.
messages.gui.spacing_bandwidth: KDE bandwidth 用于 normal-间距 distribution. 输入 0 到 select bandwidth automatically.
messages.gui.spacing_minimum: 最小 法向间距 retained 在 analysis. 值 at 或 below this threshold are filtered out 之前 calculating 密度曲线.
messages.gui.spacing_dtolerance: Tolerance used 到 group 聚类平面 使用 same fitted D 值. Smaller 值 require closer D 值 到 be considered same plane.
messages.gui.persistence_family: 组 到 analyse. 选择 全部 到 calculate 延续性 用于 every 可用 discontinuity set.
messages.gui.persistence_dtolerance: Tolerance used 到 group clusters 使用 same fitted D 值 into a single plane 之前 延续性 is calculated.
messages.gui.persistence_export: Also save 延续性 tables 和 figures 到 已选择 folder.
